text: Event documentation is authored in asyncapi.yaml per service, with a CI job publishing a static AsyncAPI Studio site per repo and a company-wide catalog aggregating all specs by subject and server.
label: architecture

text: Chose a polling-based sync with Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 over Streaming API after three outages traced to missed CometD events during Salesforce maintenance windows.
label: decision

text: The Salesforce connector runs a Kubernetes CronJob every 10 minutes that issues a Bulk API 2.0 query with SystemModstamp > last_sync, streams results into S3, and upserts into Postgres with a merge statement keyed on sf_id.
label: architecture

text: Adopted a provider-abstraction layer in front of SendGrid and SES after a four-hour SendGrid outage burned the launch email window for a $2M campaign.
label: decision

text: Transactional email routes through an internal email-svc that exposes a single HTTP API, holds provider credentials for SendGrid, SES, and Postmark, and fails over on 5xx or DKIM failures using a weighted-round-robin policy.
label: architecture

text: Switched from direct Stripe calls in each service to a central payments-svc after PCI scope audits started covering every repo that imported the Stripe SDK.
label: decision

text: All services call an internal payments-svc gRPC API whose handlers wrap Stripe, Adyen, and Braintree SDKs, keeping card tokens inside a single PCI-scoped deployment with VPC-isolated egress to provider endpoints.
label: architecture

text: Mandated OpenTelemetry propagation across all API boundaries after a cross-service bug investigation stalled because the edge gateway dropped the traceparent header.
label: decision

text: Every HTTP ingress and egress point passes through an OpenTelemetry middleware that reads and writes W3C traceparent and tracestate headers and emits spans to the Tempo collector over OTLP/gRPC.
label: architecture

text: Added a 60-second leeway on JWT nbf and exp after a burst of spurious 401s traced back to a partner's VM drifting two minutes ahead of NTP.
label: decision

text: The API's JWT middleware uses jose.jwt.decode with leeway=60, enforces audience=api.example.com, and emits a structured audit log entry on every leeway-triggered acceptance for later drift monitoring.
label: architecture

text: Enabled Brotli content encoding on response bodies after large JSON payloads on the /search endpoint made up 35% of egress traffic during peak hours.
label: decision

text: Envoy sidecars apply the Brotli compressor filter at quality 5 for application/json and text/* responses above 1 KB, with a fallback Gzip compressor for clients that advertise only gzip in Accept-Encoding.
label: architecture

text: Put all LLM calls behind an internal llm-gateway after Anthropic SDK upgrades required coordinated rollouts across seven repos last quarter.
label: decision

text: The llm-gateway exposes a single /chat/completions endpoint mirroring the OpenAI schema, translates to Anthropic, Google, and local vLLM backends internally, and handles retries, spend caps, and prompt caching per virtual key.
label: architecture

text: Adopted the Model Context Protocol as the contract for IDE-side tools after maintaining three different JSON-RPC dialects across Claude Code, Cursor, and internal VS Code extensions became untenable.
label: decision

text: IDE integrations speak JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio or streamable-HTTP implementing the MCP 2025-06-18 spec, with each tool server registered under a shared .mcp.json manifest and transport selected per environment.
label: architecture

text: Moved from direct LaunchDarkly client imports in each service to an OpenFeature SDK after swapping providers required rewriting 140 callsites across the monorepo last time.
label: decision

text: Services consume flags via the OpenFeature SDK with a flagd provider configured to read from a localhost:8013 sidecar, keeping business code free of provider imports and letting the platform swap providers via Helm values.
label: architecture

text: Switched integration tests from a shared staging to per-PR ephemeral environments after two teams stepped on each other's seed data on the same afternoon twice in a month.
label: decision

text: Every PR spawns a per-branch Kubernetes namespace via vcluster with its own Postgres and Redis instances, seeded by a fixtures Job, and the integration-tests Argo Workflow targets that namespace and tears it down on merge.
label: architecture

text: Adopted recorded VCR-style fixtures for partner webhook handlers after a Shopify schema tweak silently broke order ingestion and only surfaced through a customer complaint 48 hours later.
label: decision

text: Webhook handler tests replay cassettes stored under tests/fixtures/webhooks/<provider>/*.yaml through vcrpy, asserting both the parsed domain event and the outbound DB writes, with a nightly job re-recording against provider sandbox accounts.
label: architecture

text: Introduced a mobile BFF after the React Native team kept composing 6-8 REST calls per screen and eating the battery on cold starts.
label: decision

text: A dedicated mobile-bff service exposes screen-shaped GraphQL queries to the React Native app and internally fans out to the users, catalog, and orders gRPC services, caching aggregated responses in Redis for 30 seconds.
label: architecture

text: Standardized on an X-Tenant-ID header propagated through every hop after query-parameter and subdomain-based tenancy both leaked data in separate incidents last year.
label: decision

text: The API gateway stamps X-Tenant-ID from the authenticated JWT's tenant claim and Envoy strips any inbound value at the edge, while every downstream service asserts its presence and uses it as a Postgres RLS session variable.
label: architecture

text: Built a dedicated partner sandbox API after partners tested against production with seed accounts and a misconfigured script emailed 30k real customers.
label: decision

text: The sandbox API runs as a separate deployment at api.sandbox.example.com with its own Postgres, a time-capped data reset job, mocked payment and email providers, and OAuth clients scoped to sandbox:* audiences.
label: architecture

text: Moved CRM sync off synchronous API calls to an event-driven fanout after HubSpot's rate limits caused checkout latency to spike during the holiday rush.
label: decision

text: Customer lifecycle events publish to an NATS subject crm.events.>, and a hubspot-bridge consumer applies per-endpoint token-bucket rate limits and dead-letters rejected payloads into Postgres for manual replay.
label: architecture

text: Embedded an explicit payload version field in every outbound webhook after partners asked for three months of grace between schema changes.
label: decision

text: Every outbound webhook body carries api_version and event_version fields, the delivery service stores per-endpoint subscribed versions, and transformer plugins downgrade the current internal event to a partner's pinned version before dispatch.
label: architecture

text: Disabled gRPC server reflection in production after a security review flagged it as schema disclosure for internal methods not in the public proto.
label: decision

text: The production gRPC servers compile with -tags=noreflect, while staging and dev builds enable grpc.reflection.v1.ServerReflection behind an mTLS-only listener on :9001 for grpcurl-based debugging.
label: architecture

text: Added Toxiproxy into the integration suite after a network partition on a partner's side took down the checkout service for eleven minutes, revealing a missing timeout.
label: decision

text: Integration tests run partner calls through a Toxiproxy container with named proxies per provider, and pytest fixtures inject latency, timeout, and reset toxics to exercise each outbound client's retry and circuit-breaker policy.
label: architecture

text: Standardized all outbound HTTP traffic on a single httpx client wrapper after a service opened 40k short-lived TCP connections per minute and exhausted ephemeral ports.
label: decision

text: Services import a shared http_client module built on httpx.AsyncClient with per-host connection pools (max_connections=100, max_keepalive_connections=20), a tenacity-driven retry policy, and OpenTelemetry instrumentation installed at import time.
label: architecture

text: Switched the emergency fund from a Chase checking account to Marcus HYSA after I realised a year of inflation had eaten most of the interest.
label: decision

text: Six months of expenses sit in a Marcus HYSA at 4.1% APY, auto-funded via a $500 monthly transfer from the Chase checking account on the 5th of each month.

text: Moved the taxable brokerage from Robinhood to Fidelity after a third outage during a market open made me worry about execution reliability.
label: decision

text: Taxable investing runs through a Fidelity cash management account linked to a Fidelity brokerage, with dividends auto-reinvested and a monthly $1,000 buy order for VTI on the 15th.

text: The 401k is 70% FXAIX (S&P 500), 20% FSPSX (international), and 10% FXNAX (US bonds), rebalanced quarterly and contributing 15% of salary up to the federal limit.

text: Consumer debt is paid in avalanche order: the 24.99% Kohl's card, then the 21.5% Amex Blue, then the 6.8% federal student loan, with $1,200 extra principal per month split by priority.

text: The primary residence carries a 15-year fixed mortgage at 5.5% with Rocket, $2,480 monthly PITI, escrowed property tax and homeowners insurance, and a biweekly payment schedule.

text: Dropped the Chase Freedom Unlimited for the Citi Double Cash after realising the 1.5% everywhere rate was worse than a flat 2% with no rotating categories to track.

text: The credit card stack is Amex Gold for dining and groceries, Citi Double Cash as the 2% catch-all, and the Chase Sapphire Preferred held only for the travel portal and trip insurance.

text: Cancelled the Chase Sapphire Reserve and opened the Capital One Venture X after the $550 annual fee could no longer be justified without the old Priority Pass restaurants.

text: Travel rewards funnel into a Venture X at 2x on everything, with the $300 travel credit used against Capital One Travel bookings and the 10,000-mile anniversary bonus offsetting the fee.

text: Moved from spreadsheet-only budgeting to YNAB after the third month of categorising transactions by hand on Sunday nights became unsustainable.

text: Short-term savings live in Ally buckets: Vacation at $150/month, Home Repair at $300/month, Car Replacement at $250/month, and Christmas at $100/month, each with a visible target.

text: The kids' college savings sit in a Utah my529 account with an age-based moderate option, $400 monthly auto-contribution per child, and grandparents contributing via the Ugift link on birthdays.

text: The estate is structured as a revocable living trust holding the house and brokerage accounts, with pour-over wills, healthcare directives, and durable powers of attorney stored in a fireproof safe.

text: The insurance stack is a $3M umbrella over auto and home, Geico on two vehicles with 100/300/100 liability, a 20-year $1M term life policy, and long-term disability at 60% of salary through work.
